case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your response, but your proposed prices do not reflect the reality of our manufacturing costs.
In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are willing to agree to your proposed 24-month contract term.
This longer commitment allows us to offer a revised price of €52.10 per unit.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 December 2026: €52.10 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised offer; we appreciate the movement you have shown. As the owner of Demo Gießerei GmbH, I deeply value our long-standing partnership and trust this step brings us closer to a mutually beneficial agreement. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our main offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. This quote is valid for 30 days. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

To reciprocate, we are lowering our price to €51.20 for the 24-month contract starting 1 December 2026. Specifically, as an alternative option, we can offer a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your continued movement; we value our reliable cooperation just as much as you do. For generations, our foundry has stood for trusted craftsmanship and strong partnerships within our region. To bring us closer to a conclusion, we are reducing our price to €50.60 for the 24-month contract starting 1 December 2026. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For this final Angebot, our terms are a price of €50.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a start date valid from 1 December 2026. Our offer remains valid for 7 days. We trust this further concession demonstrates our commitment to finding a mutually acceptable agreement.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
